page_title: UDI 2-0 TOR | Udinese v Torino 02/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+4' Luca Marianucci (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+3' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+3' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alberto Paleari, who pulls off a comfortable save!
89' 4:2 – the corner kicks stats. The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:17.
88' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
86' Valentino Lazaro sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Matteo Prati (Torino), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
86' The referee awards a corner and Valentino Lazaro (Torino) goes over to take it.
85' Good clearance! Sandro Kulenovic (Torino) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juan Arizala is coming onto the pitch as Arthur Atta (Udinese) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
81' Alieu Njie (Torino) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

80' What a great effort! Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
79' It could have been a good chance to score! Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) fails to release Idrissa Gueye with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
77' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Christian Kabasele and he is replaced by Branimir Mlacic (Udinese).
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) is replacing Lennon Miller.

75' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
74' A pass by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
71' Here comes a substitution. Giovanni Simeone is given a rest as he is replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).

71' Ambitious effort from Giovanni Simeone (Torino). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. Giovanni Simeone (Torino) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
70' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) replacing Adam Buksa.
69' Substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) on for Kingsley Ehizibue.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:6. The current number of shots on goal is 6:1.
67' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' A substitution has been made. Rafael Obrador is replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino).

64' It's unbelievable, Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Alberto Paleari reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
63' Rafael Obrador (Torino) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
63' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
61' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
61' Giuseppe Mucera blows the whistle, Rafael Obrador (Torino) is penalised for a foul.
58' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
57' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Cesare Casadei is replaced by Matteo Prati (Torino).
57' Substitution. Sandro Kulenovic (Torino) has come on for Emirhan Ilkhan.

56' Adam Buksa (Udinese) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Alberto Paleari, who pulls off a stunning save!
54' The ball is cleared after Cesare Casadei (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' 2 - 0 Gooal! Lennon Miller takes over corner duties. Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 2:0.
51' Lennon Miller (Udinese) is about to take a corner kick.
51' Oumar Solet (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.

50' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Alberto Paleari pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rafael Obrador (Torino) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Mucera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' A poor mid-range free-kick by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
47' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee. Christian Kabasele (Udinese) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
46' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Oumar Solet (Udinese) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
42' Cesare Casadei (Torino) sends a long ball forward to Valentino Lazaro, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Udinese will take a throw-in.
41' The foul by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) was seen by Giuseppe Mucera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
39' Luca Marianucci (Torino) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

36' Oumar Solet (Udinese) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header low into the middle of the goal, but Alberto Paleari keeps it out.
35' Dangerous play by Saul Coco (Torino). Giuseppe Mucera blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
32' The corner kick from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

32' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
31' 5:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 0:1.
30' Luca Marianucci (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.
29' Arthur Atta (Udinese) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
28' Arthur Atta (Udinese) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
25' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
24' The goal by Udinese is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
23' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Udinese players aren’t happy.
22' Goal! 1:0. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
22' Adam Buksa (Udinese) fails to score from inside the six-yard box as he sends his rebound against the left post.
21' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
19' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
18' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Giovanni Simeone (Torino), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
17' Ball possession – 53:47.
16' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
16' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Maduka Okoye, who smothers the ball.
14' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a long through ball to Cesare Casadei, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
12' Nicolo Zaniolo sends the ball into the centre of the box from the corner. Oumar Solet (Udinese) bursts through a crowd of players but heads the ball miles wide of the left post.
12' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

11' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
10' Giuseppe Mucera blows his whistle for a foul after Nikola Vlasic (Torino) hacks down one of his opponents. Udinese have a free kick.
9' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

9' Rafael Obrador (Torino) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' Adam Buksa (Udinese) probably handled the ball. It's a free kick to Torino, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
7' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Maduka Okoye is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
3' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Torino will take a throw-in.
2' Lennon Miller (Udinese) works the corner short.
1' Arthur Atta (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Udinese will take a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Today's referee will be Giuseppe Mucera.
